name: Geshem
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return

points: When Sanballat the Horonite, Tobiah the Ammonite, and Geshem the Arabian hear it, they laugh them to scorn, despise them, and ask what this thing is, and whether they will rebel against the king.

note.label: Nehemiah 2: The King Sends Nehemiah to Rebuild

points: When Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem the Arabian, and the rest of the enemies hear that the wall is built with no breach left, though the doors are not yet set on the gates, they turn to another plan.

note.label: Nehemiah 6: The Wall Finished Against the Enemies' Plots

points: Sanballat and Geshem send for Nehemiah to meet together in one of the villages in the plain of Ono, but they think to do him mischief.

note.label: Nehemiah 6: The Wall Finished Against the Enemies' Plots

points: The letter reports among the heathen, and Geshem says it, that Nehemiah and the Jews think to rebel and that this is why he builds the wall, that he may be their king.

note.label: Nehemiah 6: The Wall Finished Against the Enemies' Plots

cases.name: Sanballat, Geshem, and Noadiah
cases.charge: Laughing the work to scorn; conspiring to fight against Jerusalem; sending four times to draw Nehemiah to the plain of Ono to do him mischief; an open letter charging rebellion; hiring Shemaiah and the prophetess Noadiah to put him in fear
cases.preview: Sanballat the Horonite, Tobiah the Ammonite, and Geshem the Arabian were grieved that a man had come to seek the welfare of Israel;
